confirmation.restatement: You'll be long QQQ whenever its closing price is above its 200-day moving average, otherwise fully in cash. Decisions use each day's close and execute at the next day's open. Each trade pays 2 bps commission and 3 bps slippage. Test window: 2010-01-04 to 2020-12-31 on SYNTHETIC sample data (bundled sample series — not market data). The final 30% is an access-controlled, single-use holdout. It is evaluated once at base costs after the rule and plan are locked; it is never used for tuning or counterfactuals. Benchmark: buy-and-hold QQQ from your strategy's first tradable decision, paying the same entry costs. The battery uses fixed-rule expanding walk-forward folds on development data, development-only cost stress, and preregistered regime analysis. It performs no parameter search or selection and always reports falsification findings. Confirming runs this battery; it does not make this strategy advisable, and no performance exists until the run completes. Validation Battery v2 locks the confirmed rule before execution. It uses development-only expanding walk-forward evaluation without parameter tuning, then permits exactly one primary read of an access-controlled final holdout. The research agent receives development evidence only. The local capability boundary is not yet an independent OS principal or object-store ACL; those remain production hardening gaps.
